key: Planetary Gear: Torque Input - Reduced Order
title: Planetary Gear
text: Ideal planetary gear with sun, ring, and carrier, 4 inputs, 6 outputs; {Port Configuration} sets the configuration, {Sun to planet ratio, Nsp} sets the ratio, {Sun to ring ratio, Nsr} sets the ratio, {Sun inertia, Js} sets the inertia .003, {Planet inertia, Jp} sets the inertia .001, {Ring inertia, Jr} sets the inertia .01, {Carrier inertia, Jc} sets the inertia .002, {Sun viscous damping, bs} sets the damping .001, {Ring viscous damping, br} sets the damping .001, {Planet viscous damping, bp} sets the damping .001, {Carrier viscous damping, bc} sets the damping .001, {Initial sun velocity, ws_o} sets the angular speed and {Initial carrier velocity, wc_o} sets the angular speed. Values come from the instance.
